doc.text:
ModSubState Constructor.
Inherits from MusicBeatSubstate and allows the execution of an HScript from assets/data/states passed via parameters.

params._stateName: Name or path to a HScript file from assets/data/states.
params._data: Optional extra Dynamic data passed from a previous state (JSON suggested).
